reasoning_content: Node 24 required. Let me install node 24 via nodesource or nvm. I'll use nvm or direct binary. Let me install nodejs via NodeSource.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_24.x -o nodesource_setup.sh && bash nodesource_setup.sh >/tmp/ns.log 2>&1; echo "setup exit=$?"; apt-get install -y nodejs >/tmp/node-install.log 2>&1; echo "install exit=$?"; tail -3 /tmp/node-install.log; node --version; npm --version
